verdict.summary: The exact V8 module is a defensible root-handle-relative, source-handle-bound replacement building block for one bounded Hosea operation only if a fresh or exhaustively inventoried Windows/NTFS host is quiescent, OneDrive and every uncooperative writer are excluded or explicitly accepted by the human exception, the caller rejects non-regular or reparse target states, and the caller preserves the full residual-race and rollback gates. It is not race-free, set-atomic, power-loss durable, portable, or publication authority.

nt_root_relative_rename.basis: The primitive retains a verified non-reparse directory handle, creates and opens leaves with NtCreateFile relative to that handle, and renames with NtSetInformationFile FileRenameInformationEx using that same RootDirectory and a validated single component.
nt_root_relative_rename.limits: This binds the destination object and leaf but does not serialize another actor replacing that leaf between the immediate preimage snapshot and the rename.

directory_identity_and_reparse_handling.basis: The destination root is opened with OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, required to be a directory, rejected if the final root object is a reparse point, retained throughout the operation, and compared to the caller-pinned FileIdentity.
directory_identity_and_reparse_handling.limits: Earlier path components may have been resolved before the final root handle was obtained; safety therefore rests on the pinned final directory identity and subsequent root-relative operations, not on pathname immutability.

source_identity_and_reparse_handling.basis: The private source is created with FILE_CREATE under the held root, FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE, is rejected if reparse, is written and hashed through its retained handle, and denies write and delete sharing through rename and readback.
source_identity_and_reparse_handling.limits: The caller must pin the exact adapter and intended bytes; the primitive itself is an environment-bound runtime adapter.

target_reparse_replacement_without_trave.basis: A final target reparse entry is opened with FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and its reparse buffer is hashed, so the supplied test correctly demonstrates replacement of the link entry without traversal or victim mutation.
target_reparse_replacement_without_trave.architecture_discrepancy: The frozen architecture ruling requires the immediate destination preimage to be a regular, non-reparse file. The generic primitive accepts a caller-pinned reparse preimage instead.
target_reparse_replacement_without_trave.required_treatment: The V8 Hosea caller must reject every target whose immediate preimage or recovery classification is reparse, directory, or otherwise non-regular. The successful generic reparse-leaf behavior must not be used to weaken exact_preimage, exact_stage, or unknown recovery classification.

wrong_preimage_temp_and_source.basis: The implementation validates intended SHA-256 before mutation, compares the held root identity, compares the full immediate EntrySnapshot, requires exclusive FILE_CREATE for the private temporary, rejects target/temp aliasing and unsafe basenames, and cleans a not-yet-renamed source by its held handle.
wrong_preimage_temp_and_source.limits: EntrySnapshot does not expose a separate size field requested by the architecture ruling, although hashing the complete handle-read bytes cryptographically binds length as part of the byte string.

post_replace_readback.basis: The still-open source handle denies delete/write sharing after it becomes the destination entry; the primitive verifies source identity and bytes through that handle, then independently reopens the leaf under the retained root and requires identity/hash convergence.
post_replace_readback.residual: Once the primitive closes the published source handle and returns, an uncooperative writer or OneDrive can change the destination before a higher-level completed journal transition or postpublication check. This primitive cannot close that readback-to-completed race.

rollback_suitability.basis: The same root-relative replacement can mechanically install archived preimage bytes while binding current destination identity and stage bytes.
rollback_suitability.required_treatment: The transaction layer, not this primitive, must classify the current target as exact_preimage, exact_stage, or unknown. Rollback may replace only exact_stage with the exact archived preimage. Unknown must remain recovery_required. Fresh wrapper-level rollback and restart tests are still required before use.

sentinel_handle_semantics.basis: The exact three-file guard opens regular non-reparse sentinel objects with read sharing only, verifies their handle snapshots on entry, explicit verify, and exit, closes partially acquired handles on entry failure, and blocks later write/delete/rename opens in the supplied tests.
sentinel_handle_semantics.residual: Windows share modes are prospective; the guard cannot revoke write or delete capability already granted to a handle opened before the guard. Handle verification also proves the retained file object, not perpetual pathname identity after the guard closes. Fresh-host/process-inventory and quiescence gates therefore remain mandatory.

cleanup.basis: Before rename, the exact private source handle is marked delete-on-close; all handles are closed; cleanup failure becomes CleanupError and is not silently ignored.
cleanup.limit: If both the main operation and cleanup fail, CleanupError replaces the main exception as the raised error. This is fail-closed but the transaction receipt must preserve both causal states if diagnostic completeness is required.

mandatory_residual_race_acknowledgment.basis: The primitive refuses to start unless acknowledge_residual_race is true and its result forbids power-loss, set-atomicity, and uncooperative-writer-exclusion claims.
mandatory_residual_race_acknowledgment.gap: RESIDUAL_RACE_SCOPE describes only an update through the already-open old target object. It does not itself name a concurrent destination-entry delete/rename/replacement between precheck and rename, nor a change after the primitive closes its published handle. old_target_changed_after_preimage_check observes the old object and must not be treated as proof that the directory entry was unchanged.
mandatory_residual_race_acknowledgment.required_treatment: The exact, hash-bound human exception and V8 wrapper receipt must explicitly acknowledge all frozen architecture-ruling races: precheck-to-rename lost update, post-handle-close/readback-to-completed stale state, pre-patch resident writers, and OneDrive/non-Python writers. A bare boolean or a false old_target_changed_after_preimage_check value is insufficient evidence of quiescence.

red_team_findings.title: Primitive-level residual wording and telemetry do not cover destination-entry substitution
red_team_findings.risk: A different entry can be installed after the old-object snapshot and overwritten by the rooted rename while the retained old-object snapshot remains unchanged. The result flag may therefore be false despite a directory-entry lost update.
red_team_findings.resolution: Do not use the result flag as a quiescence attestation. Bind the architecture ruling's complete race list into the human exception, wrapper preflight, journal, and postpublication checker.

red_team_findings.title: Generic primitive accepts a pinned reparse target despite the frozen regular-file requirement
red_team_findings.risk: The safe no-traversal behavior could be mistaken for authority to publish or rollback over an unknown/reparse canonical state.
red_team_findings.resolution: Require the Hosea V8 caller to reject target preimages and stages that are not regular non-reparse file_bytes before calling the primitive.

red_team_findings.title: Sentinel sharing cannot revoke a pre-existing writer
red_team_findings.evidence: windows_nt_rooted_replace_v2.py lines 833-895 and Windows handle-sharing semantics preserved by the architecture ruling
red_team_findings.risk: A writer or delete-capable handle acquired before the guard may operate despite the later read-only sharing request; final handle verification detects many changes but cannot establish universal writer exclusion or rule out an ABA restoration.
red_team_findings.resolution: Require fresh host or exhaustive process inventory, OneDrive/non-cooperating-writer quiescence, and postpublication verification. Treat uncertainty as a hard block.

red_team_findings.title: Primitive tests do not prove transaction-level rollback classification or completed-state safety
red_team_findings.evidence: The exact 25-test primitive matrix covers one-file replacement and sentinel behavior, not a 13-target journal, exact_stage-only rollback, restart, or completed journal transition.
red_team_findings.risk: Mechanical primitive success could be overgeneralized to transaction correctness.
red_team_findings.resolution: Require fresh exact-hash V8 wrapper transaction, abrupt-failure, restart, rollback, sentinel-lifetime, and postpublish tests before any publication request.

fresh_validation.scope: No repository file was edited; any transient C:\tmp state is non-authoritative.

required_conditions_before_v8_use: Reverify the exact module, test, architecture-ruling, wrapper, transaction-kernel, journal, target allowlist, archive, stage, and human-exception hashes immediately before use.
Use only the exact reviewed Windows/NTFS host and held parent identities; make no portable or cross-runtime claim.

Obtain an explicit, expiring Lowell Wong environment exception for exactly the 13 Hosea book-local targets, fresh-host or exhaustive process inventory, OneDrive and other writer quiescence, residual lost-update/stale-completion races, and process-crash-only recovery.
Reject every target or rollback state that is directory, reparse, non-file_bytes, wrong identity, wrong hash, wrong stage, or unknown.
Hold the shared Hosea permitted-writer lock and mechanically exclude all patched legacy writers for the full transaction.
Hold the exact three verified global sentinel handles through the final completed-state transition.
Use the same rooted primitive for forward and rollback replacements, while allowing rollback only from exact_stage to the exact archived preimage.

Treat any inventory uncertainty, source/root/preimage drift, sentinel drift, cleanup failure, post-readback mismatch, unknown recovery state, or hash mismatch as recovery_required and a hard publication stop.
Run fresh exact-hash wrapper transaction, recovery, premortem, independent checker, and separate boss review after the immutable V8 generation is complete.
Perform distinct postpublication source, literary, transaction, and path/hash checks before considering any later global sidecar installation.

preserved_dissent.reason: The primitive necessarily leaves destination-entry lost-update and post-handle-close stale-state races to environment quiescence, while its own residual string and result flag do not fully describe those races. A reviewer may reasonably require an offline or otherwise deterministic writer-exclusion environment instead of accepting the scoped exception.

harness_roadmap_assessment.candidate: A future environment-bound publication harness should test pre-existing writer handles, directory-entry substitution between precheck and rename, exact_stage-only rollback, sentinel lifetime through completed state, and post-handle-close drift.
harness_roadmap_assessment.reason_no_change: This independent checker was expressly read-only except for this verdict artifact; the candidate is recorded here for later governed routing.
